text:
About 0.5 ha of native forest overlaps the 2022 tree-cover loss on this 17.6 ha property, so roughly 3% of the property's area. Here is the breakdown:

- Hansen/UMD mapped about 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss in 2022 (3.41% of the property).
- The MGAP 2021 forest map classifies 0.5 ha of that area as native forest and 0.1 ha as outside mapped forest. None of it is planted forest.
- The JRC 2020 reference agrees the area was forest, and later years of data corroborate the loss.
- A further 0.2 ha of loss came in patches too small (under 0.5 ha) to count as an event.

This shows tree-cover loss in a native-forest context. It does not establish deforestation, the cause (harvest, fire, storm or clearing), legality, who was responsible, or any compliance status.
